exposure: Induction of labor with prostaglandin analogs
Length of first stage of labor >=720 min
Length of second stage of labor >=240 min
outcome: Admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 73 consecutive NICU admissions and 375 consecutive non-NICU admissions of infants delivered between 36.0 and 42.0 weeks at a specific institution.
finding: Several antepartum and intrapartum factors, including induction of labor, prolonged labor stages, prolonged rupture of membranes, and various maternal and fetal complications, were significantly associated with an increased risk of NICU admission for infants delivered between 36.0 and 42.0 weeks.
mod_finding: Induction of labor with prostaglandin analogs, length of first stage >=720 min, and length of second stage of labor >=240 min were significantly associated with an increased chance of NICU admission.
